scripts.env:setup:
[ -f .env ] || echo 'DATABASE_URL="postgresql://postgres:password@localhost:5432/job-board"
JWT_SECRET=<YOUR_JWT_SECRET>' > .env && echo 'Created .env - add your JWT_SECRET'
scripts.certs:export: mkdir certs && touch certs/corporate-root-ca.crt && for cn in KAINOS-INSPECTION KAINOS-ROOT-CA 'Zscaler Root CA'; do security find-certificate -a -c "$cn" -p /Library/Keychains/System.keychain; done > certs/corporate-root-ca.crt
scripts.db:sync: npm run env:setup && npx prisma generate && npx prisma migrate deploy
scripts.db:reset: npx prisma migrate reset --force && npm run prisma:seed
scripts.db:setup: npm run env:setup && npm run db:sync && npm run prisma:seed
